newsitem.title: USA: Illinova expects utility reform in Illinois.
newsitem.headline: Illinova expects utility reform in Illinois.

text.p: Illinova Corp on Wednesday predicted Illinois lawmakers will change the way electric utilities operate in the state, although the company did not speculate on a timetable.

In comments at Illinova's annual meeting, Chairman Larry Haab said he expects Illinois lawmakers to vote on legislation that will reform the electric utility industry in one of two ways. Either customers and utilities will be pushed into competition in 1998 or a time line will be established for a more gradual transition to competition, Haab said.
Haab said Illinova favors a gradual approach toward increasing competition among utility companies.
Illinova is a utility holding company.
Its shares were up 1/8 Wednesday at 20-5/8.
